terms.comment: The tree of wet ground and river banks. In the poets also a boat, since boats were made of it (Verg. G. 1.136, Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: flūminibus salicēs crassīsque palūdibus alnī nāscuntur, sterilēs saxōsīs montibus ornī
phrases.english: willows grow by rivers and alders in thick marshes, barren ashes on rocky hills

sources: Lewis & Short: alnus
